entities.name: Bernard Faÿ

entities.summary: Marie Louis Emmanuel Bernard Faÿ was a French historian of Franco-American relations, an anti-Masonic polemicist who believed in a worldwide Jewish-Freemason conspiracy. During World War II he was an official for Vichy France.
